Container.Name: mirage
Container.Overview: Real-time 3D music visualizer. Self-hosted, API-driven, shareable sessions with 26 scenes powered by Three.js.
Container.Description: Mirage is a standalone, self-hosted web app for real-time 3D music visualization with 26 scenes, mic audio input, texture uploads to Cloudflare R2, and shareable sessions.

Config.Name: Admin Email
Config.Description: Initial admin email (required for first-time setup)

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Initial admin password (min 8 chars, required for first-time setup)

Config.Name: JWT Secret
Config.Description: JWT signing secret (leave empty to use Admin Password as fallback)

Config.Name: Allow Registration
Config.Description: Set to 'false' to disable public user registration

Config.Name: Secure Cookies
Config.Description: Set to 'true' only if accessing Mirage over HTTPS. Leave 'false' for plain HTTP.

Config.Name: Debug Logging
Config.Description: Set to 'true' to enable verbose server logging

Config.Name: R2/S3 Bucket
Config.Description: R2 or S3 bucket name for texture storage (optional)

Config.Name: R2/S3 Region
Config.Description: Use 'auto' for Cloudflare R2, or a region for AWS S3

Config.Name: R2/S3 Access Key
Config.Description: R2 API Token Access Key ID

Config.Name: R2/S3 Secret Key
Config.Description: R2 API Token Secret Access Key

Config.Name: R2/S3 Public URL
Config.Description: Optional: r2.dev or custom domain URL for direct texture serving (bypasses proxy)

Config.Name: Database Path
Config.Description: Path to SQLite database inside container
